items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: In 1930 Louis Armstrong came out to the coast -- he came by himself, and he fronted our band -- you know -- played the band.

ctx.x: -- alternate engagements or alternate sets, or how did it work?

Well, for awhile we had stars come in and they would play with our band -- with the house band. One of the first ones that I remember like that was Louis Armstrong. In 1930 Louis Armstrong came out to the coast -- he came by himself, and he fronted our band -- you know -- played the band.
And if anyone thinks they've ever heard Louis now, or later years, they should have heard Louis in 1930. The most beautiful trumpet player I've ever heard.
